projects.title: Sushi Guy
projects.description: Sushi Guy is a frontend website concept for a private chef and catering service. It features a clean, user-friendly booking experience where customers can explore culinary services, choose an experience, provide their event details, and proceed through a prepayment flow. The project focuses on the website’s design, layout, responsiveness, and overall user experience.

projects.title: CabangRun
projects.description: CabangRun is a frontend website concept for a local running club, designed to showcase the club’s past races, upcoming events, activities, and achievements. The website provides a central space for runners and visitors to explore the club’s events, learn more about its activities, and stay connected with the local running community.
